hero.title: AI customer service for webshops and Shopify, 24/7
hero.subtitle: In e-commerce, fast customer service is critical to success. Delayed replies to customer inquiries mean lost sales and bad reviews. But staffing customer service 24/7 is expensive and complex.

mainCard.title: AI-powered customer service that never sleeps
mainCard.description: Aibooking.dk gives you AI-powered customer service that never sleeps. The system instantly answers common questions about products, delivery times, returns, and order status. Anything the AI can't resolve is waiting in your dashboard with a summary so your team can follow up. The dashboard shows every conversation with a transcript, recording and short summary, so you can see what customers ask about and improve your answers. Reduce response times from hours to seconds and significantly improve customer satisfaction.
